name: Assembly
summary: Assembly's Empower plan costs $3 per user per month, billed yearly. The pricing page lists peer recognition, a global reward catalog, points with budget controls and people analytics for that plan. The Enterprise plan has no published price, and the page directs buyers to a demo.

facts.text: The Empower plan lists peer-to-peer recognition, a global reward catalog, points and budget controls, and advanced people analytics.
The Enterprise plan has no published price. The page offers a demo instead.

plans.name: Empower
plans.notes: Billed yearly. The page shows a $ sign with no currency code, so the amount is recorded as USD. No minimum is published

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: No price published. Demo offered instead

hiddenCosts: The pricing page does not state a minimum contract size or a free trial.
